summary.intent: Close out the 68.1 web-client-runtime-integration exit-gate triage plan (13th iteration) for CipherBox: land the bug-fix commits from the background triage agent, run wave-close gates, and verify the phase goal was achieved.
summary.outcome: 5 real bugs were fixed and committed (createFolder retry wiring, folder-store UUID/ipnsName id desync, dropped v2.0 details-dialog fields, unwired batch-download UI, unwired kind-cache causing files to render as folders); TDD, crypto/core regression gates passed and VERIFICATION.md was committed, but the full web-e2e suite was not re-confirmed green and WEB-04 was deliberately left unmarked in REQUIREMENTS.md/ROADMAP.md due to two newly surfaced gaps.

repo: CipherBox web client bugs in this phase were consistently 'lower-level logic already correct, but never wired into the UI layer' — e.g. a working kind cache never consulted by FileListItem/ContextMenu (causing PDFs to be treated as folders and media-preview crashes), and a complete batch-download handler that was never rendered.

Folder-store had an id desync bug: it mixed UUID and ipnsName as identifiers, which was the dominant root cause behind most of the originally-17 failing web-e2e spec groups for nested-folder creation.
createFolder was missing retry-on-ReconcileStaleError wiring, a gap distinct from the id-desync bug but compounding the same nested-folder-creation failures.
workflow: Background/continuation agent sessions can lose the in-progress TaskCreate/TaskUpdate list across the hand-off; when that happens, proceed with the remaining linear sequence manually rather than trying to reconstruct the task list.

Wave-close process for this project: spot-check + build gate, test gate, drift gates, code-review/TDD advisory gate check, then regression gate (crypto+core suites) before spawning the phase verifier agent.

friction: Task list (TaskCreate/TaskUpdate state) did not survive the session hand-off from the background triage agent, forcing the assistant to proceed without it.

Despite fixing 5 real bugs, the full web-e2e suite could not be re-confirmed green — two new gaps (GAP-1: resolveFileMetadata AEAD decrypt failure for CTR video + batch-download; GAP-2: cold-reload multi-level IPNS DFS timeout) emerged, blocking a clean WEB-04 close.
open_items: GAP-1: resolveFileMetadata AEAD decrypt failure affecting CTR video and batch-download needs root-causing.
GAP-2: cold-reload multi-level IPNS DFS timeout needs investigation.
WEB-04 left unmarked in REQUIREMENTS.md/ROADMAP.md pending resolution of GAP-1/GAP-2 and other pre-existing known gaps.
SHARE-WRITE-KEY threading gap (write-share key propagation) remains open per prior project memory [[project-cipherbox-collect-child-keys]].
